profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer & Salesforce Developer
profile.summary:
I'm a former high-school math & physics teacher who transitioned into software engineering. I have a passion for education, social service, and the outdoors. I bring a collaborative and outgoing personality to any team ensuring everyone's voice is heard and ideas valued. I'm a pragmatic and pessimistic thinker who often asks the right questions to catch anything that would have otherwise slipped through the cracks.

Leveraging agile methodologies, I've led cross-functional teams through OKR setting, ensuring alignment across product, design, engineering, and leadership divisions. This collaborative approach, paired with my background in technical consultation, enables me to deliver tailored solutions that drive continuous improvement.

positions.title: Senior Salesforce Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Smithfield, Rhode Island, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leveraged the agile process to create company internal apps that served over 140,000 users and received an average 96% satisfaction score
- Created REST APIs for the mobile app team to consume, creating utility classes that diminished future development time
- Used React components to increase development speed and maintain uniform design
- Researched and consulted on 3rd party integrations & emerging technologies. Successfully integrated the Microsoft 365 API with Salesforce saving admins countless time spent manually creating mailing lists & reducing risk
- Facilitated OKRs during quarterly meetings to cross-align product, design, engineering & leadership before beginning a major project
- Mentored junior engineers
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Web Engineering · Software Infrastructure · SQL · Python (Programming Language) · REST APIs · JavaScript

positions.title: Associate Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Developed industry specific, user-friendly, mobile and web apps using the Salesforce cloud platform
 
- Collaborated and communicated with BAs, DMs, PMs, Solution Architects, and developers in Agile teams to ensure the best possible solution while maintaining efficiency and pace
- Configured native Salesforce to leverage OOTB solutions and used Apex alongside custom Lightning Web Components to provide the most customizable solutions for specific and complex needs
- Tech Stack: Apex, Omnistudio, Lightning Web Components/Apps, Javascript, HTML, CSS, REST APIs, SOQL, Angular
- Maintained deployment pipelines using GitHub and Azure
- Created thorough technical documentation to ensure successful training and transfer of knowledge
- Constantly looked for Salesforce innovation to implement
- Mentored new hires to adapt and succeed in the virtual workplace

positions.title: Project Based Learning Presenter & Coach
positions.description:
Preceptor presenter to audiences of educators wanting to learn about PBL. Individualized coaching to teachers across the world. 
- Created and maintained presentation content 
- Presented to audiences of up to 180 educators from diverse backgrounds
- Individually coached educators
- Chosen for a small group of presenters to travel to Sydney

positions.title: Mathematics & Physics Teacher
positions.description:
Not your ordinary school. 
- Planned and created 4 week projects in detail for students to collaboratively create a final product and presentation that met the required metrics of a real world challenge and client
- Managed time and materials for students to be able to learn at the most efficient pace while keeping their diverse backgrounds in mind 
- Modeled how to work in groups including heavy organization and soft skills
- Increased state assessment scores by 7%
- Chosen for the Hollyhock Fellowship, a private professional development program during the summers at Stanford
- Chosen to travel to different math conferences and collaborate with teachers on presentation material
- Projects I created were highlighted by UTeach Maker

positions.title: Safety Report Intern
positions.description:
- Met with chemical engineers to discuss parameters that were needed for different refinery units and set up thresholds to flag warnings 
- Used in-house software that used VBA to query through thousands of sensors to create monthly monitoring reports 
- Cut down on time spend creating reports by 80%

projects.title: Sushi-Junai Restaurant Website
projects.description: First iteration of a website that myself and four other bootcamp alumni completed for a real world client in under 2 weeks! All made from scratch! We used React and MySQL to create a page where customers could create a cart based and even save favorites to their profile after they've logged in!

projects.title: Google Book Search
projects.description: This react application displays books saved to a Mongo database. Users can search for a book using the Google Books API. They can view the results and save a book to the database. The 'react book favorites' page displays all book in the favorite database. The books have information such as title, authors, description, link to google books, and an image. The react app is connected to the server using express.
